bottleneck.description: Top-3 global machine tool/sheet-metal fabrication vendor; competes with TRUMPF, Bystronic, Mazak, Mitsubishi, Chinese entrants.

dependency.key_customers: Mid-market metal fabricators, auto and aerospace component shops
dependency.key_suppliers: Laser sources (IPG, TRUMPF, nLIGHT), CNC controllers, hydraulic/electric drives

editorial.notes: Amada is a top-3 machine tool franchise (~9.5% share) with strong brand and customer captivity in mid-market fabricators, but the segment has multiple credible substitutes (TRUMPF #1, Bystronic, Mitsubishi, Salvagnini, Trumpf-owned brands) plus increasing Chinese low-cost entries. Switching costs are real but bounded; no sole-source position.
